title: Rapid EDA, Baseline Models, and Submission Files for ML Competitions
text: goal sprintML help data scientists hackathon competitors go raw data strong baseline submission fast possible. time running competition, don’t want waste hours writing boilerplate code basic exploratory data analysis (EDA) model training. sprintML provides seamless pipeline understand data, handle missing values, train cross-validated machine learning models (like Random Forests SVMs), generate perfectly formatted submission files.
